items.title: [supplier] SUP-EXAMPLE Example Assets Ltd: contract CTR-EXAMPLE-ASSETS (Asset inventory subscription) is a draft, covering SOL-EXAMPLE-ASSETS. Levels: dependency 2, maturity 3. Read scope/third-parties/sup-example.yaml before you answer.
items.why: A supplier is approved before any system it provides is registered, so nothing enters the scope through a supplier no one has looked at.
items.effect: Contract CTR-EXAMPLE-ASSETS becomes active with your name and today's date; the next scope apply writes the supplier to CISO Assistant.
